title: Stop check accepts the lane branch from its ship record after the claim is released
body: Source: lane t-trnrx1h (PR #1204, merged) ended on a false Stop BLOCKER again: once its task closed, the ship released the claim, so the new claim-based branch lookup in src/hook/stop.ts found no claim and fell back to the session cwd branch `main`.

Outcome: the Stop check that matches a reported PR to the lane branch also accepts the branch from the session's ship record (the record `krn pr ship` writes for the merge) when no live claim remains.
Why: every lane that ships and closes its task from a main-checkout cwd still ends on a false BLOCKER.

Proof: `node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts` gains a case: cwd main checkout, no claim, a ship record naming branch `lane-x`, final message naming a merged PR with head `lane-x`: pass; another head: refused.
